vo.en: You always buy the most expensive option.

visual.description: Close-up of a man's finger tapping the highest tier on a digital self-checkout terminal screen.

vo.en: Quick test. A small coffee is three dollars, and a large is seven.

visual.description: Steaming dark coffee pouring smoothly from an elegant steel gooseneck kettle into a glass cup.

vo.en: Now add a medium for six-fifty. Suddenly, that seven-dollar cup looks like an absolute steal.

visual.description: Time-lapse of crisp paper dollar bills being stacked and slid across a smooth wooden table.

vo.en: Wait until you see the creepy truth behind this.

visual.description: Extreme macro shot of a male pupil sharply constricting as bright cyber-blue light flashes across the eye.

vo.en: MIT behavioral studies proved nobody buys the medium. It is an engineered decoy built to force your brain into picking the highest price.

visual.description: Overhead view of a metallic ball bearing racing through a complex wooden labyrinth maze.

vo.en: Streaming apps, movie theaters, and tech giants use this asymmetric trick daily to pull billions from your pocket.

visual.description: Low-angle time-lapse of glowing commercial skyscrapers in a major financial district at twilight.

vo.en: Subscribe for tomorrow's mind trick and comment YES if this fooled you, which is why...

visual.description: Overhead shot of a man's hand strategically moving a heavy metal chess piece across a dark board.
